source: VOKA 3D Anatomy & Pathology, section Embryologie / 1er trimestre (jours post-fecondation)
avertissement: Les CRL sont des valeurs de la litterature (O'Rahilly & Muller 2010 ; Moore & Persaud), pas des mesures VOKA. Les ages VOKA sont des jours post-fecondation (J91 = 13 semaines).
usage: Reference visuelle externe uniquement (enveloppe, proportions, aspect de la peau). Aucun maillage n'est extrait du viewer. Les structures internes viennent de nos coupes.

stades.reperes: Bourgeons des membres superieurs, 4 arcs pharyngiens, vesicule optique, otocyste ferme. Corps en C.
stades.description_voka: Examine the human embryo at Day 28, a period marked by rapid organogenesis and the early development of the heart and limb buds. This 3D visualization makes complex structures and spatial relationships easier to comprehend than traditional 2D resources. It is highly beneficial for embryology students, healthcare professionals, and researchers focused on prenatal development, offering a reliable reference for study, teaching, and analysis of early human growth patterns.

stades.reperes: Palette de la main, fosse nasale, cupule optique avec cristallin, 4 arcs, hemisphères cerebraux.
stades.description_voka: Learn about the developmental stage of a Day 35 human embryo, highlighting the advanced formation of the brain, eyes, and major organ systems. This model provides a comprehensive and interactive perspective on organ development and body patterning, making intricate processes more accessible for learners. It is especially useful for medical students, educators, and researchers who need accurate visual representations to support training, research, and clinical understanding of early embryonic growth.

stades.reperes: Rayons digitaux de la main, pied en palette, nuque marquee, bourrelets auriculaires, pigment retinien.
stades.description_voka: Explore the human embryo at Day 42. This 3D model offers a detailed view of early organ development and spatial relationships between emerging structures, making complex processes easier to understand. It is particularly useful for medical students, embryologists, and educators who need accurate visual references for teaching, learning, and research in early prenatal development.

stades.reperes: Doigts separes (encoches), tronc s'allonge et se redresse, coudes, membres inferieurs en avant.
stades.description_voka: This detailed visualization of the human embryo at Day 49 highlights the further development of the heart and nervous system. By presenting these changes in three dimensions, the model enables students and researchers to study organogenesis with clarity and precision. This 3D model is invaluable for medical education, embryology courses, and scientific investigations focused on early human development and congenital anomaly research.

stades.reperes: Fin de la periode embryonnaire : tete arrondie, paupieres, doigts et orteils libres, queue disparue, hernie ombilicale physiologique.
stades.nos_coupes: aucune (stade manquant -> proportions a prendre sur VOKA)
stades.description_voka: Step into the Day 56 stage of human embryonic growth, when limb differentiation progresses and the major organ systems become more defined. This interactive 3D model makes it easier to observe intricate developmental changes and understand their spatial context. It is highly beneficial for medical trainees, educators, and developmental biologists seeking reliable references for studying embryonic progression.

stades.reperes: Tete ~ moitie du CRL, yeux fermes, ongles debutants, hernie ombilicale encore presente.
stades.nos_coupes: aucune (stade manquant -> proportions a prendre sur VOKA)
stades.description_voka: Observe the human embryo at Day 63, showcasing nearly complete formation of major organ systems and the refinement of limb structures. This 3D model provides a practical way to visualize complex developmental processes that are difficult to grasp from textbooks alone. It is especially useful for medical students, educators, and researchers who require accurate and interactive tools for teaching, learning, and analyzing early human development.

stades.reperes: Intestin rentre dans l'abdomen, visage humain, membres proportionnes.
stades.nos_coupes: aucune (stade manquant -> proportions a prendre sur VOKA)
stades.description_voka: Explore the human embryo at Day 70, when the limbs, digits, and facial features become increasingly distinct, and organ systems continue to mature. This 3D model offers a clear spatial representation of these developmental changes, helping learners visualize complex structures and their relationships. It is particularly valuable for medical students, embryologists, and educators who need accurate anatomical references for study, teaching, and research in early human development.

stades.reperes: Sexe externe reconnaissable, cou visible, ossification primaire etendue.
stades.nos_coupes: aucune (stade manquant -> proportions a prendre sur VOKA)
stades.description_voka: This 3D visualization of a Day 77 human embryo highlights ongoing refinement of the heart, brain, and skeletal structures. This model provides an interactive way to observe the progression of organ development, bridging the gap between theory and practical understanding. Medical students, educators, and researchers will find it especially useful as a reliable resource for studying early prenatal growth.

stades.reperes: Tete ~ 1/3 du CRL, membres superieurs a leur longueur relative finale, membres inferieurs encore courts.
stades.nos_coupes: aucune (stade manquant -> proportions a prendre sur VOKA)
stades.description_voka: Learn about the development of a human embryo at Day 84, a stage where limbs, joints, and facial structures show advanced differentiation. This 3D model allows close examination of the spatial relationships and maturation of organs, making early embryonic development more accessible. It serves as an essential tool for medical trainees, educators, and developmental biologists who require precise visual references for education and research purposes.

stades.reperes: Fin du 1er trimestre ; corps s'allonge, tete relativement plus petite.
stades.nos_coupes: aucune (stade manquant -> proportions a prendre sur VOKA)
stades.description_voka: Observe the human embryo at Day 91, when major organ systems are well-established and structural refinement continues throughout the body. This interactive 3D model provides a comprehensive view of development, supporting the study of normal growth patterns. It is particularly beneficial for medical students, educators, and researchers seeking detailed and practical tools for teaching, learning, and analyzing early prenatal development.
